# Boulevard Recording (Kerblabs concept)

> Unofficial concept page for a one-room recording studio at 6035 Hollywood Blvd, Hollywood, CA 90028. Facts from boulevardrecording.com. Not the studio's official site.

- Hours: Mon-Fri 10am-10pm, weekends by arrangement
- Phone: (323) 337-6911
- Booking: https://www.boulevardrecording.com/contact
- Console: Sound Techniques ZR36, 36 input channels, installed 2023
- Sessions: recording, mixing only, recording plus mixing, overdubs, drum tracking
- History: Continental Sound Recorders 1967, Producers Workshop 1975, Westbeach Recorders 1988, Boulevard Recording 2011

Q: Where is it? A: 6035 Hollywood Blvd, Hollywood, CA 90028.
Q: How do I book? A: Use the contact form with project type and estimated dates.
